QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Dreamy Bloody Mushroom Wine
QuestInfo.1: The basic ingredient for this dish is the #bCursed Cat Spittle#k. It also needs #bGreen Mushroom Caps or Blue Mushroom Caps#k. Be sure to look around carefully, as they say that the frogs and cats roam around town when they are hungry. Sure, you might feel a bit wary about eating something that the Witch prepared...but it's not like you'll die, right?
QuestInfo.2: After reciting a strange chant, the Witch makes you a dish that doesn't look too appetizing.
